verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Devin ships a desktop app (Desktop getting-started docs, a 100-page Desktop doc section) and documents running independent tasks simultaneously. Nothing shows visual diff review or side-by-side multi-session views inside that desktop app, so only the desktop-app part of the story is established. missing for 10: documented visual diff review UI, evidence of side-by-side multi-session layout in the desktop app, independent or hands-on corroboration.
